attributes.title: Sheet
attributes.lede: The finger lets go. The spring takes the same value.

lesson.concept: A detent can be an interface mode
lesson.why: The sheet's release chooses among detents, and each detent changes how a share target is presented. The throw predicts intent while shared identity connects the different representations.
lesson.experiment: Release at similar positions with different velocities. Check which mode wins and whether the same target remains recognizable after the sheet settles.
lesson.pitfall: Choosing a detent only from the final pointer position ignores release velocity; excessive prediction makes the sheet feel uncontrollable.
lesson.combine: Combine with presence and layout to retain departing modes until their transitions complete.
